data.text: [00:03.8]Today on This is Your Life, we are talking about a woman who is probably one of the most famous and influential women in the world. `[00:13]Going back to her early life, she was born on January the 17th 1964, and grew up in Chicago, USA. `[00:23]She did well at school and then went on to get a law degree from Harvard University in 1988.

[00:31]After graduating, she worked at a law company in Chicago. `[00:36]This is where she met her future husband, who was working for the same company. `[00:42]They got married on October the 18th 1992. `[00:47]She has had an impressive career, with senior positions in several large companies and universities.

[00:56]Looking at family matters, in July 1998, she had her first child – a daughter called Malia. `[01:05]And a second daughter, Natasha (known as Sasha) followed in June 2001. `[01:12]After her husband was elected to the US Senate, she and her husband decided to keep their children in Chicago. `[01:21]She wanted to continue with her career, as well as keeping a stable family life for the children.

[01:28]Currently, she is the First Lady of the United States, and manages to juggle being a mother, a career woman and the wife of the President. `[01:39.9]She usually goes to bed by nine thirty and gets up each morning at four thirty to go running. `[01:48]It is this discipline that helps her keep calm and organised in her busy, stressful life.
